events.publisher: YouTube data as presented in 2024 YouTube Gaming quiz

measures.scope: All tracked videos related to Splatoon 2 in Japan, not one game trailer

events.limitations: Dated Japanese views within release week. No matched prelaunch views, country platform denominator, video set definition, or causal launch-effect estimate.

measures.scope: GTA VI Trailer 1, a single video
Related GTA VI videos, a broader set overlapping the trailer

events.limitations: A pre-release trailer event, not the game's later launch. >93M and >250M are lower bounds on overlapping units; cannot sum, subtract lower bounds, or infer incremental platform growth.

necessary_for_lift: Matched before and after windows for same game and metric
Same geographic and channel/video observation frame
Comparison with other games and platform-wide trends
Documented pre-registration of window and event type
confounders: new trailer is itself new video supply
view metric definition change on August 24 2026
prohibited_inferences: Gaming views are not unique people or new users of YouTube.
A prelaunch trailer is not the date of a game release.
Views of a single trailer overlap all related video views.
An observed release-window total without a matched baseline cannot establish a causal launch uplift.
Japanese seven-day video views cannot be compared as if commensurate with global one-day trailer views.
2017/2023 events cannot directly predict 2026 platform growth or creator revenue.

view_metric_epoch: Both event periods predate the August 24, 2026 first-frame public-view revision. Current event studies must record revision boundaries.
